criteria.description: The workbook opens and the paired data and requested analysis are identifiable without relying on sheet names.
Every paired-difference row uses Group 2 minus Group 1 and is numerically correct.
Paired sample size and mean difference agree with the independent analysis.
Paired SD, SE, t statistic, and degrees of freedom agree with the independent analysis.
The two-sided paired-test p-value uses the declared method and agrees with the independent analysis.
Both 95% confidence-interval bounds agree with the independent paired analysis.
The planned paired sample size equals the declared normal-approximation result.
A chart is bound to all ten paired-difference rows, directly or through formula-linked helper cells.
The paired-difference calculation and its chart-linked value update when a source observation changes.
The decision summary applies the declared two-sided 0.05 rule to the calculated p-value.
All ten source pairs and their subject order match the supplied observations.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查受试者配对、配对差、描述统计、双侧检验、95% 区间、规划样本量和图表。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 按表头、标签、受试者 ID 和数值关系定位，不要求六张固定名称的工作表。
accepted_equivalents_zh: 统计标签的常见近义词
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 无法确认配对身份，或不同统计量显然来自不同数据区域时，应记录为无法可靠定位。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 仍有少量真实答卷暂时算不出分，需要继续补充跨表布局。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
